title: Census dynamic G20 helper captures (PR5586 B1): none pays for one helper or any pair
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spL?thread=cmsg_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spLGuU7HdmJnoWCK2cmvkVBP1)_

## Summary

New package `research/g20-dynamic-capture-census`: an exact census of PR5586 **B1** captures (own a retained helper, keep it zero while dead, inject an arbitrary payload, delete queries whose payload vanishes) on the final PR5708 G20 BIT word. Card `bit-helper-contract`, base `19fdb086e`. No new kappa or supplier admission.

At the B1 target C = 0.0037 the PR5708 invoice needs +40.95 signed moment (+2.28 per local word); one owned full helper debits 8^t = 7.94.

- **Single helpers, all epochs:** none of the 415 helpers pays with any injected payload; best 0 (helper 684, H4 for H4), max removed rank mass 7. Every helper has exactly **one live interval**, so the multi-epoch premise of B1 has no instance on this word.
- **Pairs:** the 5 pairs whose joint ownership lengthens a dead interval all lose (exact best -1.968); all 6030 pairs with a shared query lose (5638 by a parity-class bound, 392 by exact enumeration; best -1.957).
- **Larger sets:** a parity-token bound (adapting PR5604's argument to chronological rows) limits removal to 6.5 per owned helper plus its free own query. Only helpers with a free rank-2 own query (180) can contribute, at most +0.556 each; reaching 0.0037 needs at least 5 compatible ones.
- **Positive control:** on the PR5667 word at C = 0.0035 the same census finds exactly the nine PR5671 late-binding helpers (free own H1 + removed H7), and nothing else.

## Open continuation (for anyone interested)

The complete joint search over sets of three or more helpers is not done here. TASK.json gives an encoding: restrict to the 180 helpers with a free rank-2 own query and their shared queries, encode candidate injections with exact kill conditions, and solve the weighted maximum consistent subset (ILP/MaxSAT); check any witness with `capture.py`. A second open question asks to rerun `capture.py` on any changed G20 word.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-dynamic-capture-census
```

Standard library only, under a minute; expected `PASS_G20_DYNAMIC_CAPTURE_CENSUS`. `check_research_commit.py` passes on the commit.

## Credit and scope

Dugongue (PR5586 B1, PR5665), Ali Romman (PR5421, PR5604 token argument, PR5671 control, PR5679/PR5708 words), ai-nanachi (PR5512) and all retained predecessors. Paid frame conversions, added contacts and changed words are out of scope; framework premises unchanged. Author check, not independent acceptance.
